params.body:
Three reconciles in a row were lost last night to a ten second ceiling while the Observatory was merely busy. Nothing was broken either time and a retry worked every time, which is the signature of a timeout set for the wrong kind of call.

The Observatory answers these from the single thread its engine also runs on, so a heavy phase queues everything behind it. And nobody waits on a projection read: they run on the schedule or behind a webhook, and the answer is as correct at twenty seconds as at one. So they get a minute.

The liveness probe keeps its own four seconds, deliberately and with the reason written down: there the waiting IS the question, and a probe that takes a minute to say "reachable" has answered a different one.

The test is modest on purpose. Laravel records the request that went out, not the timeout it carried, so the patience is asserted where it is set and the calls are exercised so a client that stops reaching the pipeline at all fails here rather than at four in the morning.

Suite 269 green, Pint clean.
params.title: A slow answer is not a wrong one
